label: Colour laser MFP, wired only
description: 36 ppm colour multifunction printer with 10/100/1000Base-T Ethernet and no built-in Wi-Fi. The 'dn' configuration is wired-only; wireless needs the optional Xerox adapter.
notes: Wired only (gigabit). Wi-Fi is an optional accessory, not standard - model it as Ethernet-only. No PoE; 100-240 VAC.
